## Walkthrough

This PR removes several fuzzy/*.bin entries from the ignored list in bin/test-runner/w3f-davxy-071-bin.ts so those files will be processed by the test runner; adds TestSuite.W3F_DAVXY to the accumulation statistics update condition and makes the statistics Map explicitly typed as Map<ServiceId, CountAndGasUsed>; and converts checkpointedState to non-nullable while changing getStateUpdates to return a single checkpointed state (callers updated accordingly).
